# BacksterOS documentation index

## Specifications

- [docs/00-vision.md](00-vision.md): Goals, users, non-goals, success criteria
- [docs/01-architecture.md](01-architecture.md): System diagram, repos, auth, write pipeline
- [docs/02-tech-stack.md](02-tech-stack.md): Tool choices — Expo, Tauri, Postgres, PowerSync, Meilisearch, Hono
- [docs/03-data-model.md](03-data-model.md): Sync tiers A/B/C/D, entities, version fields
- [docs/04-api-and-sync.md](04-api-and-sync.md): REST v1, sync bootstrap/pull/push, live documents, agent API (dual-hydrate **deprecated** — see 16)
- [docs/16-linear-shaped-sync.md](16-linear-shaped-sync.md): Target Linear-style sync — cloud leader, desktop as cache, kill dual-hydrate
- [docs/14-client-logic-inventory.md](14-client-logic-inventory.md): Mobile ↔ desktop pure-logic mirrors (contracts extraction backlog)
- [docs/15-tauri-ipc-profiling.md](15-tauri-ipc-profiling.md): Desktop invoke/event inventory, batching gate, system-stats watch
- [docs/05-clients.md](05-clients.md): Clients (v1-oriented; see also 12)
- [docs/11-urls-and-routing.md](11-urls-and-routing.md): /app vs /admin, reverse proxy
- [docs/06-storage-and-search.md](06-storage-and-search.md): B2/R2, Meilisearch, PDF/markdown layout
- [docs/07-performance.md](07-performance.md): iPhone 16, M1 MacBook, lightweight rules
- [docs/08-legacy-circle.md](08-legacy-circle.md): Circle monolith reference, migration notes
- [docs/09-phased-build-plan.md](09-phased-build-plan.md): Implementation phases 0–9
- [docs/10-decisions-log.md](10-decisions-log.md): ADRs
- [docs/12-v2-local-computer.md](12-v2-local-computer.md): v2 local-computer core + Expo/Tauri shells
- [docs/13-hybrid-cloud-local-core.md](13-hybrid-cloud-local-core.md): Hybrid local/cloud cores (superseded direction → 16)

## Task routing (quick)

| If you are working on… | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Starting implementation | 00-vision, 12-v2-local-computer, 09-phased-build-plan |
| API routes / OpenAPI | 04-api-and-sync, 03-data-model, 02-tech-stack |
| PowerSync / offline | 03-data-model, **16-linear-shaped-sync**, 04-api-and-sync, 07-performance |
| Expo mobile | 05-clients, 07-performance, 04-api-and-sync, 12-v2-local-computer, 14-client-logic-inventory |
| Tauri desktop | 05-clients, 07-performance, 10-decisions-log (ADR-019, ADR-020), **16-linear-shaped-sync**, 15-tauri-ipc-profiling |
| PDFs / markdown / search | 06-storage-and-search, 03-data-model |
| Changing stack choices | 10-decisions-log, 02-tech-stack |

## Conventions

- Do not develop in `legacy/`
- Never bulk-sync Tier C/D content to clients
- Business logic in `core/server/` only
- No shared visual UI between mobile and desktop
- All writes: storage → Postgres version → sync event → Meilisearch → realtime
